items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: the first little band that I first can remember that I started out playing with right here was named R.D. Jordan

ctx.x: And I remember going and listening to records at her house. Well, I see. You know, she'd take me down there. We'd listen to the records and all that. I guess that's how I got interested in music. Because you sure was wrestling in music. That's true. You like music. Well, Billy and Lady had been friends of mine for over 10 years now. I used to have a record shop. Yes, they were telling me about it. They used to come in the back and play with Melee Barnes' band when they first came around. Mm-hmm.
Well, the first little band that I first can remember that I started out playing with right here was named R.D. Jordan. That's R.D.
I heard y'all talk about it.
